description: Bornes de vélos à assistance électrique en libre-service Vélocité sur le territoire de m2A is a dataset listed in m2A open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. Localisation des nouvelles stations pour les vélos à assistance électrique Mise en service le 26 mars 2025. Coverage: Mulhouse Alsace Agglomération. The portal files it under Transport. Its keywords are borne, vélo, VAE, velocité, stationnement, Cycle. The portal shows 62 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-03-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-mulhouse-alsace-fr-portal.
